The vendor directly providing the software product at **animoto.com** is **Animoto Inc.**

### Provider Statement and Evidence
According to the official **Animoto Privacy Policy** at **animoto.com**:
> *"This Privacy Policy for Animoto Inc. (“Animoto”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) describes how and why we might access, collect, store, use, and/or share ("process") your personal information when you (“User” or “you”) interact with us, including when you: (1) visit or interact with our website at https://Animoto.com..."*

Animoto Inc. is also named as the service provider and legal entity in its Terms of Service and Copyright notices across the domain.
